name: avo
description: Work with your Avo tracking plan in Claude Code: explore, search, and design events, properties, and metrics; review and implement branches — backed by the Avo MCP server. Bundles the data-designer (existing plan) and data-designer-new-plan (greenfield) skills, use-case skills for importing a plan, designing from a PRD, bulk edits, developer handoff, and branch review, and registers the Avo MCP server.
